decisions.statement: Every file under the folder is moved whether or not the index names it.
A body that is not text is moved rather than refused.
No file outside the folder is moved.
A file keeps its place beneath the folder that file moved with.
A relative reach from one moved file to another is left as that reach is.
A body outside the folder naming a path that moved is repointed in the same answer.
A body naming the folder that moved names the folder that folder landed at.
What moved is handed down as the folder rather than as a path for each file.
Every file under the folder is answered for in one answer rather than one a file.
A body is read as the world before the move holds that body.
The module repointing a body is called rather than reached through a rung.
Which bodies are read is answered by the last part of the folder's own name.
The bodies read are the ones a search of the tree names.
A tree that could not be searched refuses rather than carrying nothing.
A body that would not read names no folder here.
A body holding words kept as they were said names no folder here.
Which bodies those are is answered by the property whose file each body is.
No importer is asked of the index, because a body naming a path names the folder.
A body the move writes still naming that folder refuses the move.
A folder already with a body at a path the move would write is refused.
A folder with no file is refused.
A folder a page claims holding a file under the folder moved refuses the move.
Such a folder is taken away before the move rather than carried or emptied here.
No file this change carries none of is taken away by this change.
The listing carried is judged against the files git tracks under the folder.
A file git tracks that the listing leaves out refuses the move and is named.
A file the listing names that git tracks nowhere is carried rather than refused.
A file git tracks that is off the disk already is judged by nothing here.
A repository git will not answer for refuses nothing here.
A folder moved under itself is refused.
A page moved with the folder keeps the slug that page had.
Nothing here changes the data a page states.
A generated body importing what moved is written by the generator.
A generated body the move carries is carried and left to its generator.
A body that is not text spells no path that moved.

definition: one folder and every file under it moved to another path
